implementation.publicServing: Published asset response includes a content-hash ETag and public max-age/s-maxage of 300 seconds; revocation cannot recall already-downloaded or offline copies and may propagate through existing public caches until their bounded TTL expires. implementation.failureCleanup: After a successful immutable Storage upload, registration failure removes only that request's generated object path. An upload error does not delete a possibly pre-existing collision path.
